2609.05198.title: What Matters in On-Policy Distillation? A Perspective on Data Efficiency and Data Selection
2609.05198.paper_summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has emerged as a widely adopted post-training paradigm for enhancing large language models in reasoning domains. However, the data-centric mechanisms in OPD remain relatively underexplored. This paper presents a empirical study of data efficiency and data selection in OPD. We begin by investigating an extreme setting: training OPD on only one example, namely 1-shot OPD. Surprisingly, we find that 1-shot OPD is consistently effective across all sampled training examples and harder examples often yield superior performance gain. We next investigate what actually drives the student model's improvement in the training data. Our analysis reveals that the improvement is not driven by high token entropy, but the longer CoT paths which hard problems naturally generate. Training on longer CoT can help maintain closer alignment with the teacher over a long reasoning horizon, and learn critical thinking patterns usually missing in short CoTs, such as reflection (e.g., ``Alternatively''). Based on these insights, we propose a simple data selection method that selects only hard examples for training, where even ``unsolvable'' examples that completely exceed the teacher's capability can be successfully used. Our experiments conducted on four models ranging from 1.5B to 7B show that training the student model on only 8 selected hard examples matches the performance of the 17K dataset baseline.
2609.05198.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）已成為增強大型語言模型在推理領域的廣泛採用的後訓練範式。然而，OPD 中以數據為中心的機制仍然相對未被深入探索。本文呈現了一項關於 OPD 中數據效率和數據選擇的實證研究。我們首先調查一個極端情境：僅用一個例子訓練 OPD，即 1-shot OPD。令人驚訝的是，我們發現 1-shot OPD 在所有抽樣的訓練例子中始終有效，而更難的例子往往能帶來更好的性能增益。我們接著調查實際驅動學生模型在訓練數據中改進的因素。我們的分析顯示，改進並不是由高標記熵驅動的，而是由困難問題自然生成的較長 CoT 路徑驅動的。對較長的 CoT 進行訓練可以幫助在長期推理視野中保持與教師的更緊密對齊，並學習通常在短 CoT 中缺失的批判性思維模式，例如反思（例如，``Alternatively''）。基於這些見解，我們提出了一種簡單的數據選擇方法，僅選擇困難的例子進行訓練，即使是完全超出教師能力的``無法解決''例子也可以成功使用。我們在四個模型（範圍從 1.5B 到 7B）上進行的實驗顯示，僅用 8 個選定的困難例子訓練學生模型的性能與 17K 數據集基準相匹配。
